name: Single-Leg Balance
setup: Stand on one leg, knee soft, the other foot just off the floor; a wall within reach.
cues: Heel, big toe, little toe: press all three into the floor.
Stand tall and still, like a post planted in the floor.
Let the foot make tiny corrections against the floor; the rest stays still.

faults.fault: Foot rolling out onto the little toe
faults.fix: Press the big-toe joint back down into the floor.

faults.fault: Hip dropping on the free side
faults.fix: Keep your belt line level, like a tray of drinks on it.

source.licence: FEL original (Final Evolution Lab), all rights reserved

name: Band Ankle Push
setup: Sit on a mat, leg long, the band ends in your hands looped around the forefoot.
cues: Push the band away with the ball of the foot, like pressing a pedal.
Push the band away on a slow, smooth path.
Hold the end of the range for a beat.

faults.fault: Turning the whole leg to move the foot
faults.fix: Keep the knee pointing at the ceiling; only the foot moves the band.

faults.fault: Snapping back to the start
faults.fix: Let the band back in on a slow three-count.
